fences.rule: What changes across is the instant: at the first pledge the promise is nearly free, the pool is untested, and the residue is the first claim; once claims are paid it is the pool running, and the seat moves from the ignition to the maintenance.
fences.case: County farmers pledging to cover any barn that burns, before the first barn has burned.

fences.rule: If the steps need an agreed plan and steady a cooperation already running, they are sequential milestones there; if one lot is given with no plan and proves only the lot, it is here.
fences.case: A freight broker giving a new carrier one load.

fences.rule: If the giver means the unasked favor as a trap to be priced later, or stages the shared enemy to lower a drawbridge, it is a mask there; if the unrefusable first turn ignites whether or not the giver ever names a price, it is here.
fences.case: The produce broker who drops a case of stone fruit at the restaurant's back door on a Friday.

fences.rule: If the device breaks a deadlock in a negotiation already running, a graduated tie, a contingent clause, an invented deadline, a commissioned enemy, it is there; if there was no relationship and the disagreement or the clock is itself the fuel of the first move, it is here.
fences.case: An earn-out inserted to break the price deadlock of a negotiation already months old.
